name: Veriss Forms
role: Backend and full-stack engineer (IEU Africa): built end to end
summary: Form builder for organizations on Veriss: registrations, applications and surveys with 18 question types, shared by link, answered without an account, and managed or exported as Excel/CSV.
description: Veriss Forms (forms.veriss.co) runs next to Veriss Payments and shares its database and organization accounts. The builder has 18 question types, per-type validation, drag-and-drop ordering, a live preview and a guard against losing unsaved changes. Forms can carry a Cloudinary banner, close themselves when a response target is reached, and show how many places are left. Changing questions after responses arrive starts a new form version, so earlier answers always display against the questions they answered. Respondents need no account and get a mobile-first form with client and server validation, upload progress and duplicate-safe submission backed by anti-spam checks. Organizations search, filter and page through responses, open them in a detail drawer and export genuine .xlsx or CSV files.
highlights: 18 question types, including file and image uploads, ratings, consent and date/time, each with its own validation settings
Form versions: editing a live form never corrupts earlier responses
Response targets that close the form automatically, with optional places-left display and email notifications
Duplicate-safe, rate-limited public submissions with honeypot and minimum-fill-time checks
Responses with dynamic columns, search, date filters, a detail drawer and .xlsx/CSV export
